setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 through a MIDI device on OUT 1: four trigs on steps 1-4 (C, D, E, F = MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65; velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) in C major at 90 BPM, with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). The Trig params screen is open on its parameter list, showing Fixed Note; every slot is empty (None).
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Fixed Note to the first slot and K2 to return. With no step held, turn E3 to 60 (C3). Play, then stop: the MIDI strip lists C3 (60) on all four steps.
steps.title: Set the channel default

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), turn E3 to 63 (D#3) and release. A value set on a held step is a lock. Play, then stop: step 2 plays 63 and the other steps keep the default, 60, 63, 60, 60.
steps.title: Lock one step

steps.caption: Hold step 1 at (1,4), turn E3 down to 0 and release. Play, then stop: 0, 63, 60, 60. Zero is a real note, not Off.
steps.title: Lock a second step

steps.caption: Hold step 4, turn E3 down to X (Off) and release: a step at X has no lock, so it follows the default. Then, with no step held, turn E3 up five detents to 65. Play, then stop: 0, 63, 65, 65. Steps 1 and 2 keep their locks.
steps.title: Raise the default beneath the locks

steps.caption: Hold step 2 at (2,4), press K2 and release: its lock is cleared and step 2 returns to the default. Play, then stop: 0, 65, 65, 65. Step 1 keeps its MIDI 0 lock; steps 2 to 4 follow the default. To lock a CC value the same way, see Brighten the last note with a cutoff lock.
steps.title: Let the default apply again

title: Lock a value, then clear just that step
